The '''Kowak system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sevetta sector/Legends|Sevetta sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kowak/Legends|Kowak]].
